chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilwayh (mercy of God be upon him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari narrated from Musa ibn 'Amr, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Sa'id al-Qummat, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Allah created the Divine Will before all things, then He created all things by means of His Will.
ai.seo_question: What is the role of Divine Will in creation according to Shia theology?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the ontological precedence of Divine Will (*al-Mashi'ah*) as the primordial faculty through which Allah initiated creation, distinguishing it from mere desire by framing it as the active instrument of existence. This concept is central to Shia theological discourse on *Tawhid al-Af'al*, affirming that all cosmic events occur solely by His deliberate will, a principle that underpins the Shia understanding of divine omnipotence and the absence of independent agency in the universe.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 8. Muhammad ibn `Ali Majilwayh (RA) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-`Attar said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn `Imran al-Ash`ari said, on the authority of Musa ibn `Umar, on the authority of Ibn Sinan, on the authority of Abu Sa`id al-Qummat that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:
“Allah created the Divine Will before all things. He then created all things by means of His Will.”
